book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn SOHN

content: Sises ketin Pwarohng Tohnpadahk Isimen
Mwurin mepwukat, Sises pil pwurehng kasalehiong tohnpadahk ko pein ih limwahn Lehen Daipirias. Eri, iet duwen eh ketin pwarohng irail:
Saimon Piter, oh Tomas (me pil adaneki Mpwer,) oh Nadaniel, mehn Kena nan Kalili, oh nein Sepedi ko, oh pil riemen sang nanpwungen sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, irail pokopokon.
Saimon Piter ahpw ndaiong irail, “I pahn kolahng laid.” Irail pil ndaiong, “Se pahn iang uhk.” Irail eri kohieila oh karadahng pohn kisin pwoht kis. A nipwongo, re sohte saikedi mehkot.
A ni eh rahnpeseng Sises ahpw ketiket ni oaroahro; a tohnpadahk ko sohte ese me iei ih Sises.
Sises ahpw mahsanihong irail, “Ser ko, mie seikamwail?” Irail eri sapeng, patohwanohng, “Sohte.”
E ahpw mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail kadaridi uhken ni palimaun en waramwailen; a kumwail ahpw pahn diarada.” Irail eri kadaridi uhko. Re ahpw sohla kak apihada, pwehki eh direkihla mwahmw.

Tohnpadahk me Sises ketin loalloale ahpw ndaiong Piter, “Iei ih Kaun-o mwo!” Ni Saimon Piter eh rong me iei Kaun-o mwo, e ahpw katengehdi eh likoun laido (pwehki eh pwuhrsangehr nan eh likoun liki kan) oh lusdiong nan leho.
A tohnpadahk teiko seiseiki kohdo kisin pwohto, pwehki re sohte dohsang sahpwo, ele piht silipwiki. Irail ruwahdekihdo uhko me direkihla mwahmw.
Ni arail keredi sang pohn pwohto, re kilangada kisiniei me mwoalusdier, oh mwahmw kei miher powe, oh pil pilawa.
Sises ahpw mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail wahdo kisehn seikamwail kan.”
Saimon Piter eri karada, waikelongodohng nan sahpwo uhko me direkihla mwahmw kalaimwun epwiki limehk silimen. Mehndahte mwahmw ako eh tohtohie, a uhko sohte ohla.
Sises mahsanihong irail, “Kumwail keido tungoal.” Eri, sohte emen sang nanpwungen tohnpadahk me eimah en idek reh, “Ihs komwi?” Pwehki re eseier me iei ih Kaun-o.
Sises eri ketila oh ale pilawao, ahpw nehkohng irail, oh pil duwehte mwahmw ako.
Eri, iei met kesilipak en Sises eh ketin kasalehiong tohnpadahk ko pein ih mwurin eh ketin iasada sang rehn me melahr akan.
Sises oh Piter

Eri, mwurin ar sakpene, Sises ahpw mahsanihong Saimon Piter, “Saimon, nein Sohn, ia duwe, ke poakohng ie laudsang mepwukat?” Piter ahpw patohwanohng, “Ei Maing ei Kaun, komw mwahngiher me I poakohng komwi.” Sises ahpw mahsanihong, “Kamwenge nei sihmpwul kan.”

E ahpw pil mahsanihong Piter keriapak, “Saimon, nein Sohn, ia duwe, ke poakohng ie?” Piter ahpw patohwanohng, “Ei Maing ei Kaun, komw mwahngiher me I poakohng komwi”’ Sises ahpw mahsanihong, “Apwalih nei sihpw kan.”

E ahpw pil mahsanihong kesilipak, “Saimon, nein Sohn, ia duwe, ke poakohng ie?” Piter nsensuwedkihla en Sises eh ketin kalelapak kesilipak, “Ia duwe, ke poakohng ie?” E ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Maing ei Kaun, komw mwahngih mehkoaros, komw mwahngiher me I poakohng komwi.” Sises ahpw mahsanihong, “Kamwenge nei sihpw kan.

Eri, I ndaiong uhk ni mehlel: ni omw mwahnakapw, ke kin pein katengepene omw kateng, oh kohla wasa me ke mwahuki. A ni omw pahn likeilapalahr, ke pahn kihdahwei pehmw kan, a emen ahpw pahn pirepene, oh kahreiukalahng wasa me ke sohte men kohla ie.”
(E mahsanih met pwe en kasalehda soangen mehla me Piter pahn kalinganahkihda Koht.) Eri, mwurin met, Sises ahpw ketin mahsanihong, “Idawehniehdo!”
Sises oh Tohnpadahk Teio
Piter ahpw sohpeila oh kilang tohnpadahko me ideidawehnirahdo, me Sises ketin loalloale—ih me penglahng pahn kupwur ni arail konokonot oh patohwan kalelapak, “Maing, ihs ih me pahn pangkomwihla?”
Ni Piter eh kilang ohlo, e ahpw patohwan idek rehn Sises, “Maing, ia duwen ohlen?”
Sises ahpw sapeng, mahsanihong, “Mehnda rehmw, ma I men ohlen en mihmihte I lao pwurodo, ke dehr kedirepwki. A kowe idawehniehdo!”

Koasoi pwoatet ahpw lohkseli nanpwungen souleng kan, me dene tohnpadahko sohte pahn mehla. A Sises sohte mahsanih me ohlo sohte pahn mehla, pwe e mahsanih, “Mehnda rehmw ma I men ohlo en mihmihte I lao pwurodo?”
Ih tohnpadahko met me kadehdedahr duwen mepwukat, oh me ntingihedier koasoi pwukat; oh se eseier me eh kadehde me mehlel.
Kaimwiseklahn Pwuhk wet
Oh pil mie soahng tohto me Sises pil ketin wiahda. Ahpw ma se pahn ntingihedi duwen mehkan koaros, I lemeleme me sampah wet sohte kak deukada pwuhk kan me pahn ntingdi.
